hand-wraps-cobalt-skulls.name: ★ Hand Wraps | Cobalt Skulls
hand-wraps-cobalt-skulls.desc: Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching. These blue bias-tape handwraps are printed with skull motifs.

driver-gloves-plum-quill.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Plum Quill
driver-gloves-plum-quill.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

driver-gloves-convoy.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Convoy
driver-gloves-convoy.desc:
These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation. It has been made with a mix of brown soft leather and dyed suede.

Sometimes discretion is called for

driver-gloves-king-snake.name: ★ Driver Gloves | King Snake
driver-gloves-king-snake.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation. It has been crafted out of white leather and snakeskin.

hydra-gloves-case-hardened.name: ★ Hydra Gloves | Case Hardened
hydra-gloves-case-hardened.desc: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Hydra logo. These vegan leather gloves have been printed with a variegated metallic pattern.

ak-47-jungle-spray.name: AK-47 | Jungle Spray
ak-47-jungle-spray.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors.

Perfect for the insurgent on the go

aug-aristocrat.name: AUG | Aristocrat
aug-aristocrat.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has silver filigree appliqués over an light blue anodized base.

For the 1%

awp-man-o-war.name: AWP | Man-o'-war
awp-man-o-war.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been given a base coat of blue metallic paint then hand-painted with metallic gold swirls and accents.

Turn some heads before you take them off

awp-capillary.name: AWP | Capillary
awp-capillary.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. A custom paint job comprised of intricate teal and coral veins has been applied.

The key to an agent's heart costs $4750

pp-bizon-chemical-green.name: PP-Bizon | Chemical Green
pp-bizon-chemical-green.desc: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been painted solid colors in grey and garish green.

cz75-auto-emerald.name: CZ75-Auto | Emerald
cz75-auto-emerald.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent emerald anodized effect paint.

This is what the great Sebastien Hennequet has been reduced to? A nagging school marm?  What happened to you... - The Teacher and The Iconoclast Part 2

cz75-auto-framework.name: CZ75-Auto | Framework
cz75-auto-framework.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. A grey and tan optical illusion hydrographic pattern has been applied.

Did you get a good look?

cz75-auto-indigo.name: CZ75-Auto | Indigo
cz75-auto-indigo.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted solid colors in indigo, blue and grey.

Alex Kincaide, I'm sure you have many questions... please allow me to give you answers - The Phoenix and The Storyteller Part 1

desert-eagle-directive.name: Desert Eagle | Directive
desert-eagle-directive.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been designed to help the future of law enforcement stop creeps.

Your move...

famas-afterimage.name: FAMAS | Afterimage
famas-afterimage.desc: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been custom-painted with broken ribbon trails.

g3sg1-murky.name: G3SG1 | Murky
g3sg1-murky.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been anodized then painted using a leopard-spot hydrographic.

There is always some place darker you can go

g3sg1-keeping-tabs.name: G3SG1 | Keeping Tabs
g3sg1-keeping-tabs.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been custom painted using Danger Zone's tactical map display as inspiration.

You have all the information you need - Franz Kriegeld, Phoenix Tactician

g3sg1-demeter.name: G3SG1 | Demeter
g3sg1-demeter.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. This memento from Ali has been painted with a mosaic hydrographic.

Patience is a virtue

galil-ar-rainbow-spoon.name: Galil AR | Rainbow Spoon
galil-ar-rainbow-spoon.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. The rainbow spoon effect is achieved by heating the painted weapon to very high temperatures. By using this method the number of unique finishes is almost infinite.

Infinite possibilities

galil-ar-black-sand.name: Galil AR | Black Sand
galil-ar-black-sand.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been custom pained in black and camo.

Mikah Baton is about to begin his campaign against the Coalition Taskforce

galil-ar-signal.name: Galil AR | Signal
galil-ar-signal.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. A hydrographic pattern of red hexagons has been applied over a dark blue base.

Information is never free

galil-ar-green-apple.name: Galil AR | Green Apple
galil-ar-green-apple.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a green and black color scheme.

An apple a day keeps insurance premiums high

p2000-imperial.name: P2000 | Imperial
p2000-imperial.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been laser-etched and painted with red and yellow metallics.

My feelings are irrelevant Keo, I have an empire to protect - Booth, Arms Dealer

p2000-ivory.name: P2000 | Ivory
p2000-ivory.desc: Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has faux ivory parts.

butterfly-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Doppler
butterfly-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

butterfly-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Case Hardened
butterfly-knife-case-hardened.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

butterfly-knife-bright-water.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Bright Water
butterfly-knife-bright-water.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

Ours is a world of intrigue...but sometimes camouflage is meant to be seen - Booth, Arms Dealer

survival-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Survival Knife | Doppler
survival-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

falchion-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Doppler
falchion-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

karambit-autotronic.name: ★ Karambit | Autotronic
karambit-autotronic.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been anodized red and uses steel mesh to lighten the weight.

m9-bayonet-night.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Night
m9-bayonet-night.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck

m9-bayonet-safari-mesh.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Safari Mesh
m9-bayonet-safari-mesh.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

skeleton-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Safari Mesh
skeleton-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

stiletto-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Doppler
stiletto-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

huntsman-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Doppler
huntsman-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

huntsman-knife-freehand.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Freehand
huntsman-knife-freehand.desc: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted black and purple, then decorated with a metallic marker.

talon-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Talon Knife | Boreal Forest
talon-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

m249-gator-mesh.name: M249 | Gator Mesh
m249-gator-mesh.desc: A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been spray-painted freehand using mesh fabric as a stencil.

m4a4-x-ray.name: M4A4 | X-Ray
m4a4-x-ray.desc: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. A custom painted M4 showing its internals with an X-Ray

mac-10-oceanic.name: MAC-10 | Oceanic
mac-10-oceanic.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been given a black base coat and accented with blue designs.

The shapeless void

mac-10-tatter.name: MAC-10 | Tatter
mac-10-tatter.desc: Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with a high-tech design reminiscent of flames.

mac-10-rangeen.name: MAC-10 | Rangeen
mac-10-rangeen.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with an Ancient Egyptian motif.

Can you stand against it's wrathful gaze?

mac-10-ensnared.name: MAC-10 | Ensnared
mac-10-ensnared.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. A custom paint job of pixies, trapped inside the weapon and eager to escape, has been applied.

They have yet to find someone they cannot fool

mag-7-carbon-fiber.name: MAG-7 | Carbon Fiber
mag-7-carbon-fiber.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been painted using a carbon fiber hydrographic over a graphite base coat.

Just because I carried my team doesn't mean it wasn't a team effort - Rona Sabri, Rising Star

mag-7-irradiated-alert.name: MAG-7 | Irradiated Alert
mag-7-irradiated-alert.desc: The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been spray-painted with radiological warning hazard patterns.

mp5-sd-agent.name: MP5-SD | Agent
mp5-sd-agent.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It has been custom painted in FBI blue and finished with yellow accents.

"It's time to earn our stories"

mp5-sd-lime-hex.name: MP5-SD | Lime Hex
mp5-sd-lime-hex.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It has been spray-painted with a blue and green hex pattern.

Hex marks the spot

mp5-sd-dirt-drop.name: MP5-SD | Dirt Drop
mp5-sd-dirt-drop.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. Black streaks have been spray painted over a dark base.

Dirt don't hurt… until it does

mp9-music-box.name: MP9 | Music Box
mp9-music-box.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A gold damask pattern has been applied.

Fight of fancy

mp9-goo.name: MP9 | Goo
mp9-goo.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been custom painted to resemble a tarlike goo obscuring a grey base.

Covered in spite

mp9-setting-sun.name: MP9 | Setting Sun
mp9-setting-sun.desc: Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been painted with a hydrographic pattern of nuclear hazards symbols.

mp9-shredded.name: MP9 | Shredded
mp9-shredded.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A multicolored tiger camo pattern has been applied.

Endangered no more

mp9-nexus.name: MP9 | Nexus
mp9-nexus.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been custom painted in silver, black, and blue with contemporary designs inlaid in the silver paint.

A personal, yet understated touch

nova-gila.name: Nova | Gila
nova-gila.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been covered in a lizard skin decal.

You're acting like you've never been held captive by mercenaries before – The Oni and The Valkyrie Part 1

p90-reef-grief.name: P90 | Reef Grief
p90-reef-grief.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. A green and blue coral pattern has been applied.

Nature laughed, for it created something we couldn't dream possible

r8-revolver-reboot.name: R8 Revolver | Reboot
r8-revolver-reboot.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has been decorated with red accents over silver and black panels.

"Have you tried turning it off and on again?"

r8-revolver-banana-cannon.name: R8 Revolver | Banana Cannon
r8-revolver-banana-cannon.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has been custom painted to resemble a very ripe banana.

Catch them slipping

sawed-off-snake-camo.name: Sawed-Off | Snake Camo
sawed-off-snake-camo.desc: The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been spray-painted using a snakeskin stencil in patches that have been outlined freehand.

scar-20-storm.name: SCAR-20 | Storm
scar-20-storm.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a stormy color scheme.

It will be waiting for you at the monorail

sg-553-army-sheen.name: SG 553 | Army Sheen
sg-553-army-sheen.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been covered in a metallic foil stamped with a camouflage pattern.

Remember your training

sg-553-tornado.name: SG 553 | Tornado
sg-553-tornado.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a tornado color scheme.

Don't be fooled by its simplicity

tec-9-hades.name: Tec-9 | Hades
tec-9-hades.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted with a hydrographic of ancient Greek helmets.

If she wanted me to conduct an interview, there was probably an easier way to book it - The Shield and The Storyteller Part 2

ump-45-labyrinth.name: UMP-45 | Labyrinth
ump-45-labyrinth.desc: The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been painted with subtle orange linework.

usp-s-the-traitor.name: USP-S | The Traitor
usp-s-the-traitor.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted using the Hanged Man tarot card as inspiration.

Past failures are the blueprints for future success

xm1014-entombed.name: XM1014 | Entombed
xm1014-entombed.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. Entombed for millennia, this recently unearthed XM-1014 has been custom painted with blue wraps and Egyptian accents.

Fit for a pharaoh

xm1014-fallout-warning.name: XM1014 | Fallout Warning
xm1014-fallout-warning.desc: The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been spray-painted with radiological warning hazard patterns.
